items.t: "Chilliwack Proper West" is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack for the western part of Chilliwack Proper; the guide page itself states the City doesn't publish a boundary for it, and gives as a rough guide the section west of the downtown core, around Young Road, Corbould Street and the airport side of Chilliwack Proper — an orientation from the addresses of schools and facilities, not a City boundary. No board- or City-published boundary exists: Not verified as an official boundary. The closest official description is the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan area, which covers the established residential area of Chilliwack Proper as a whole.
Nearby areas: Chilliwack Proper East and downtown Chilliwack (District 1881) to the east, Fairfield Island to the north, and Sardis / Vedder Crossing south of Highway 1.
Where the condo stock concentrates: the downtown/hospital side. The guide page's total feed count and the exact MLS feed filter behind it are not verified.

Plan frame: land use sits under the City's 2050 Official Community Plan (Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500), whose Schedule B2 is the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan; the plan was first added to the 2040 OCP as Schedule D through Bylaw 2018, No. 4533, with the June 5, 2018 public hearing notice stating its purpose as guiding future decision making on residential infill development. Plan designations as the guide states them: Residential 1 (one and two family housing) and Residential 2 (attached housing and narrow lot infill).
SD33's structure is elementary Kindergarten to Grade 5, middle Grades 6 to 8 and secondary Grades 9 to 12.

Transit — guide-page detail, not verified on a timetable document: the guide's transit framing is Routes 52, 57, 59 and 66 — Route 52 Evans, Route 59 Industrial (peak-period weekday trips only), Route 57 Broadway, and Route 66 Fraser Valley Express between Chilliwack and Lougheed Town Centre Station. No timetable document for any of these routes was opened pass (the fetch service returned a 429 rate-limit for further bctransit.com opens and that line was stopped), so that route detail as stated is not verified. Published drive times: Not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Chilliwack Proper West Guide

items.t: Secondary suites and ADUs: Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000 defines a secondary suite as an accessory dwelling unit of not more than 90 m² and less than 40% of the habitable floor space of the building, located within a building containing only 1 principal dwelling unit — the cap is the lesser of 90 m² and 40%. Section 4.06(1) permits only 1 ADU per lot where the zone permits an ADU (secondary suite, coach house or garden suite), and garden suites are capped at 100 m² by Section 4.06(1)(g); ADU parking is 1 space for a 1-bedroom ADU or any secondary suite and 2 spaces for a 2-or-more-bedroom coach or garden suite (s. 5.04). A suite must be built with a building permit, meet the BC Building and Fire Code and current flood protection requirements, and new secondary suites are not permitted below the flood construction level.

Flood and ALR: City-wide, 67% of Chilliwack's land (17,322 hectares) is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, and ALR residences cannot be stratified in any case (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); ALR status for any specific Chilliwack Proper West parcel is a parcel-by-parcel check on the ALC map: Not verified.

The guide page and the home area page draw Proper West differently. Guide: Young Road / Corbould Street / airport side. Area page: Yale Road West / Bernard / Ashwell / Hodgins corridors.

The Robson's build year disagrees between the directory and its own listings. Directory: 2022. Listings: 2023, consistently. The difference matters for warranty stage and depreciation-report timing, and it settles only on the registered strata plan — a buyer's agent should not repeat either year as settled until then.
One Wolfe Road complex has no citable name.

The downtown condo sits inside a form-and-character permit area. OCP Bylaw 5500's Schedule D-6 makes the whole downtown a Form & Character Development Permit Area — exterior alterations and redevelopment around The Robson run through that lens, not just the zoning bylaw.

items.t: Chilliwack Proper West is the west half of "Chilliwack Proper," the board grouping for the city-proper (downtown-side) part of Chilliwack, as distinct from the Sardis / Vedder / Garrison side south of Highway 1. Board identity: Chilliwack is a CADREB market; CADREB's own territory description covers a regional area from Yarrow to Lytton including Chilliwack, and CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only, with no sub-area tables. No board-published boundary for "Chilliwack Proper West" exists: Not verified as an official boundary.

Treat this as the page's working scope only. Nearby areas: Chilliwack Proper East and downtown Chilliwack (District 1881) to the east, Fairfield Island to the north, and Sardis / Vedder Crossing south of Highway 1.
Market numbers: none cited, and none exist in the permitted sources for this ground.
Municipality: City of Chilliwack, BC.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: one corridor — Wolfe Road across from Townsend Park, where all four counted complexes stand (45025, 45085, 45185 and 45215 Wolfe Road). The wider stock is detached homes, ranchers, infill duplexes and small-lot homes, with low-rise condos near the hospital precinct.
Published drive times: Not verified.
Addresses and facility details for these on a City of Chilliwack facility page: Not verified pass.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Chilliwack Proper West

items.t: City plan — standing correction carried: the current Official Community Plan is Chilliwack 2050, Bylaw No. 5500; in that framework the Sardis plan is Schedule B5 and the Agricultural Plan is Schedule B1.

Zoning, SSMUH, suites and ADUs: Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000 governs; its Section 6 sets the agricultural zones, Section 7 the rural zones, and Section 12 includes the RS-FHA (Flood Hazard Area) reserve zone. SSMUH: Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395, adopted June 18, 2024, allows 3 to 4 dwelling units on parcels within the urban growth boundary zoned for single-detached and duplex housing. A secondary suite is capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the building's habitable floor space (Bylaw No. 5000, s. 2); only 1 ADU per lot where the zone permits (s. 4.06(1) — secondary suite, coach house or garden suite), and garden suites are capped at 100 m². The City's Secondary Suites Policy permits rental of a suite in any single detached dwelling regardless of zone, with a building permit, BC Building and Fire Code compliance and flood-protection compliance; new suites are not permitted below the flood construction level.

Chilliwack property taxes: notices are mailed annually at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1 of every calendar year; a 5% penalty applies for taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% for taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026. This staged 5% + 5% is Chilliwack's own city scheme — do not confuse it with Mission's flat 10%, or with the rural Taxation (Rural Area) Act regime (whose second stage runs at October 31 and is paid to the Province).

Flood and ALR: flood hazard zoning exists in the bylaw structure (RS-FHA, s. 12.02 of Bylaw No. 5000) and the City applies a Floodplain Regulation Bylaw; parcel-level Flood Construction Levels for Proper West lots are not verified. The Parkside Gardens data sheet records Flood Plain: Yes for its unit — confirm the parcel's flood position with the City before subjects. ALR status inside the Proper West working scope is not verified (the scope is the urban city-proper side; check the City Webmap), and ALR residences cannot be stratified in any case (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)). Farm-classification thresholds, where a farm parcel is in issue, run in the full three-tier form (0.8–4 ha: $2,500; over 4 ha: $2,500 plus 5% of the value over 4 ha; under 0.8 ha: $10,000) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

All of the sub-area's verified townhouses share one street and one park. Townsend Terrace, Centre Field, Parkside Gardens and the 45185 Wolfe Road complex all stand on Wolfe Road across from Townsend Park — a buyer comparing "Chilliwack Proper West townhouses" is comparing four stratas on one corridor, with fees, depreciation reports and pet bylaws as the real differences.

The oldest complex on the corridor carries its plan number in the open. Parkside Gardens' MLS data sheet prints Strata Plan NWS54, 42 units in strata, self-managed, Flood Plain: Yes — a 1971 strata whose diligence is its depreciation report and its flood position, not its listing photos.

The hospital is the area's true anchor, and it is a Fraser Health community hospital — primary, core secondary and some specialty services at 45600 Menholm Road, on the Hodgins Avenue side of the Proper West ground, minutes from the Wolfe Road strata stock.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Chilliwack Proper West

items.t: Zoning — City of Chilliwack Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000: Its Section 6 sets the agricultural (farm) zones and Section 7 the rural zones, and Section 12 includes the RS-FHA (Flood Hazard Area) reserve zone.

SSMUH — Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395, adopted June 18, 2024: allows 3 to 4 dwelling units on parcels within the urban growth boundary zoned for single-detached and duplex housing, per the City's staff report and the amendment record in the consolidated Zoning Bylaw No. 5000.

Suites and ADUs (Bylaw No. 5000, ss. 2 and 4.06): only 1 ADU per lot where the zone permits an ADU; a secondary suite is capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the habitable floor space of the building and must sit within a building containing only 1 principal dwelling unit; garden suites are capped at 100 m². The City's Secondary Suites Policy permits rental of secondary suites within any single detached dwelling regardless of zone, built with a permit and to BC Building and Fire Code and current flood protection requirements; new suites are not permitted below the flood construction level.

Property taxes (City of Chilliwack): notices are mailed at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1 each year; for 2026, a 5% penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chilliwack Proper West

items.t: There are no Chilliwack market statistics to quote — from anyone. Price land and houses from the property's own CADREB comparables.

Proper West's plan is a schedule, not the city-wide text alone: the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan sits as Schedule B-2 of OCP Bylaw No. 5500, and the 2050 OCP review folded its land uses into city-wide designations while its neighbourhood policies remain in the plan — a lot buyer reading only the OCP's general residential policies misses the Proper-specific layer.
Tax penalty dates are Chilliwack-specific: 5% after July 2, 2026 and a second 5% after August 4, 2026 — not the September second-penalty date used by some neighbouring cities.
